messages.subject: selectROI: wrong position
messages.body_plain:
Hi, I try to select ROI from the mse dataset using

image(mse, mz=1200)
ROI1 <- selectROI(mse, mode="region")

but when i select in a specif position, the script tale the region from another and unwanted position.
I am using Rstudio.
Somebody had the same issue of mine

thank you

Marco

messages.subject: Re: selectROI: wrong position
messages.body_plain:
the problem has been solved... it was a problem regarding the resolution of my display. The display zoom in Rstudio has to have the same value of monitor's one.

Marco

messages.subject: SelectROI()
messages.body_plain:
Hello Cardinal users

I am running an experiment consisting of several tissue microarrays and need to select the single cores and label them accordingly. I use the SelectROI() function but it often causes R to abort the session. I was succesfully able to do so for a small subset of the data (still while aborting once in a while) but for the full dataset (680.000 pixels with app. 600 features) it crashes the first time I call the function.

Could this be a memory issue? I've tried on two separate machines with 64 and 126 GB of RAM respectively.

Thanks in advance,
Andreas
